reason: The flora says the bark is grey or brown. Bark, colour and both values match.
In 'A by B cm', the first range is the length: 8–25 cm, up to 46 cm. That matches. The leaflet bearer is correct.

fix: When the context is a corolla, 'lower lip' / 'upper lip' should map to corolla lip (FLOPO_0985017), not to the whole corolla. The earlier review's rule C398 already does this for 'corolla lower lip'.
reason: The 6 mm length belongs to the lower lip of the corolla, not the whole corolla. The corolla tube alone is about 5 mm.

fix: 'basal leaf blades' should set the position slot to basal leaves. The text says the leaves vary along the stem, so this shape holds only for the basal leaves.
reason: The text opens with 'Leaves various, decreasing in size from stem base to apex'. Spatulate to oblanceolate is said only of the basal leaf blades, so dropping 'basal' makes the claim cover all leaves.
'Unarmed' means the plant has no spines or prickles. Recording it as not spiny for the whole plant is the usual reading.

'Scapes ± overtopping leaves' means the scape is longer than the leaves, roughly. In a Taraxacum the scape is the leafless peduncle, so the peduncle bearer and the 'approximately' qualifier are acceptable.

fix: When a vein count is resolved, its container must be the leaf or blade, not 'vascular bundle'. The word 'vein' seems to have been sent to vascular bundle and then used as the container.
reason: The count and the 'each side of midvein' position are right. But a container of vascular bundle says there are 8–12 secondary veins inside a vascular bundle, which is wrong.

target: base of leaflet (leaflet PO_0020049 with place slot 'base'), position: middle pinnae
fix: In 'base subequilateral', the symmetry belongs to the base. Keep 'base' as a place slot on the pinna and do not drop it.
reason: The flora says the base of the middle pinnae is nearly equal-sided. It does not say the whole pinna is symmetrical.
'1-veined' for the dorsal sepal is recorded as one vascular bundle in the sepal. That is correct.
'pétales 5' means 5 petals. This is said in the male-flower sentence, but in this genus the female flowers also have 5 petals, so the claim stays true.

fix: In 'rounded-deltate', the 'rounded-' modifier is dropped and only triangular is kept. That is acceptable because the shape is still deltate.

target: bearer: leaf lamina abaxial side; stage: mature (after young); pilose limited to the midrib

reason: The underside of the blade is sericeous when young and later becomes glabrous, or stays pilose along the midrib. The annotation drops the stage, the underside and the midrib limit.

fix: In an inflorescence context (spikes, bracts, flowers), 'rhachis'/'rachis' should map to inflorescence axis (inflorescence rachis), not leaf rachis.

fix: Under 'Calyx ...; tube ...; lobes N', the lobes are calyx lobes (FLOPO_0986005, a reviewed local bearer), not free sepals.

The leaves are not septate-nodulose. The negation scope is right.

'Herbs' means the whole plant is herbaceous.
